CreateReportRequest.description: Select stored artefacts to include. Unknown fields are refused.
CreateReportRequest.title: CreateReportRequest

evaluation_instant.description: Instant at which evidence freshness is judged. Defaults to the current time for ad-hoc runs; the seeded demo uses a fixed instant. Always stored with the run.
evaluation_instant.title: Evaluation Instant

EvidenceRecord.description:
One observation about one field of one element.

``value``/``unit`` are exactly what the source reported. Canonicalisation
happens in the resolver so the conversion stays auditable.
EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord

FaultDefinition.description:
One explicitly modelled adversarial condition.

``phase_ids`` is the fault's **scope**. An empty list means "every phase in
the experiment". A multi-entry scope is the multi-phase case (G6-06/F8):
the fault is applied to exactly those phases and no other, which preserves
the independent phase-snapshot model.
FaultDefinition.title: FaultDefinition

FaultKind.description:
The supported fault-injection primitives (MASTER_PROMPT §8, Gate 6 G6-06).

Only a mutation the domain can genuinely represent is listed. Each entry
maps to one authoritative operation - see ``faults.py`` for the mapping.
FaultKind.title: FaultKind

FaultObservation.description:
An explicitly synthetic observation introduced by a fault.

``synthetic`` is forced to ``True`` and the provenance class cannot claim to
be a field measurement: injected observations are synthetic by construction
and must never be presented as evidence collected on site (GATE-6 INV-9).

note.default: Synthetic observation injected by an explicitly modelled Failure Lab fault. It is not a field measurement and carries no field provenance.
note.title: Note

source.default: DETOUR LAB Failure Lab (synthetic adversarial observation)
source.title: Source

FaultObservation.title: FaultObservation

GraphEdit.description: Typed, auditable graph modification applied to a scenario revision.
GraphEdit.title: GraphEdit

ImportRequest.description: A local-planar dataset payload (the seeded demo format).
ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest

OriginDestination.description: OD endpoint bound to a **graph node ID**, never to a nearby coordinate.
OriginDestination.title: OriginDestination

Phase.description:
Construction phase with an explicit ordering convention.

Demo phases use logical ordinals. No construction calendar is invented.
Phase.title: Phase

ProvenanceClass.description: PRD §11.1 — data categories must never be blended without provenance.
ProvenanceClass.title: ProvenanceClass

RunExperimentRequest.description:
Execute bounded experiments against one stored scenario revision.

``extra="forbid"`` means a typo is a ``422`` rather than a silently ignored
field that would change what was actually executed.
RunExperimentRequest.title: RunExperimentRequest

expected_revision.description: revision the client believes it is editing
expected_revision.title: Expected Revision

SearchBudget.description: User-entered budget. No exchange rates are ever invented.
SearchBudget.title: SearchBudget

TemporaryEdge.description: Ephemeral path that exists only in declared phases.

field_verification_note.default: Modelled edge only. Field constructibility has not been confirmed by any engineer.
field_verification_note.title: Field Verification Note

TemporaryEdge.title: TemporaryEdge

info.description: Pre-construction pedestrian detour decision support and model verification. Verdicts are 'Pass in modeled checks' / 'Fail' / 'Unknown' / 'Not applicable'; they are never a legal, regulatory or safety certification. All bundled data is synthetic.
info.title: DETOUR LAB API
